configurations.name: Run Web EDU di HP Android USB
configurations.command: lsof -ti tcp:8080 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/webedu-server.log 2>&1 & adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d http://localhost:8080/index.html
